Remarks: This needs further study (emphasizing on developmental study) of this mite to get a better idea about its association with freshwater sponges. This species was reported from Haiti (Lundblad 1935), Oaxaca State, Mexico (Cook 1980), Guatemala (Viets 1975), and the Panama Canal Zone (Gliwicz & Biesiadka 1975). Viets (1975) suggests that Stoll's (1877) species may have been U. gracilipalpis tenuis.
